name: readcube-papers
title: ReadCube Papers
description: Search and browse your ReadCube Papers library (requires a ReadCube Papers account)
author: nightowl

commands.name: search-papers
commands.title: Search Papers
commands.subtitle: ReadCube Papers
commands.description: Search the papers in your ReadCube library

commands.name: browse-lists
commands.title: Browse Lists
commands.subtitle: ReadCube Papers
commands.description: Browse your ReadCube libraries and lists

preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Email
preferences.description: The email you use to sign in to ReadCube Papers

preferences.name: password
preferences.title: Password
preferences.description: Your ReadCube Papers password (stored securely by Raycast)

preferences.name: sessionCookie
preferences.title: Session Cookie
preferences.description: Alternative to email and password (for SSO accounts): the Cookie header of any sync.readcube.com request in your browser's developer tools

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
